definition.name: Mix_plus_GPS
definition.definition: Mix+(A) reduction — an improved version of Mix(A) that conditions on the Schur sampling outcome lambda. Given n copies of rho, (1) apply the purification channel Phi^{d,r}, obtaining Young diagram lambda (with ell(lambda) rows), (2) re-run the purification channel Phi^{d,ell(lambda)} (using the actual number of nonzero rows rather than the rank bound r), (3) run pure-state algorithm A on the result, (4) partial-trace out the ancilla. The key improvement: the SWAP coefficient in the second moment becomes E[ell(lambda)]/n^2 instead of r/n^2, which can be significantly smaller when rho has decaying eigenvalues. Mix+(GPS) implements a conditional PGM over the rank-ell(lambda) Hilbert-Schmidt measure.
